feeds.title: Hawaii Magazine
feeds.description: Hawai'i Magazine shares stories about what makes the Islands so luring and unique to mindful travelers who love and respect this place as much as Hawaiians do. The magazine inspires its readers to travel here with an open mind and heart, to malama (care for) the home, and to seek out authentic experiences through its rich and rooted storytelling in the magazine and on digital platforms.

feeds.title: A Maui Blog
feeds.description: My name is Liza Pierce and I have been living in Maui since 1994. I started blogging as a Mommy Blogger in 2005. I like talking about Maui stories with Visitors and locals alike and I want to share Maui with you. I want you not only to enjoy Maui but also to love and take care of it.

My interests include classical music, Broadway musicals, art museums, Hawaii, New York, Europe, Thailand, Korea, beautifying our home, enjoying married and family life, and blogging.

feeds.title: Inside the life of a makeup artist
feeds.description: Aloha, Welcome To Honolulu Hawaii Lifestyle Blogger and Makeup Artist Brandy Gomez-Duplessis blog, Inside The Life Of A Makeup Artist. She shares makeup tips, how to's, on set entertainment, BTS beauty industry pics, bridal makeup, and beauty testimonials, all while living with Lupus, Lyme disease, RA & Asthma. She shares her life of what it's like being a REAL makeup artist in the beauty industry.

feeds.description: Hawaii Travel, Living In Hawaii & Things To Do In Hawaii. Aloha! I'm a local Hawaii girl traveling Hawaii's beautiful islands! My goal is to provide helpful hints and tips for Hawaii visitors while bringing aloha wherever I go in the world.

feeds.title: Hawaii Food and Family
feeds.description: Hawaii Food and Family is a lifestyle blog that connects families together through tradition, food, and experiences. Authored by Cari Chung.

feeds.title: Maui Hacks
feeds.description: I'm Christie Smith. My goal is to answer all the questions someone might have about visiting the islands, including info on beaches, hikes, restaurants, lodging, flight tips, etc. My intent with the site is to share the beauty of Hawaii, encourage respect for Hawaiian culture, people, and land, and help visitors have an amazing and safe visit.

feeds.description: I'm Leialoha. Welcome to my little corner of paradise! I hope my writing and adventures will inspire you to live a beautiful & satisfying life by creating paradise wherever you are. I love turtles, Hawaii travel, my husband, and all things coconut!

feeds.description: Aloha Lovely is an island-inspired lifestyle brand offering apparel and accessories as well as curated wellness, style, and travel content. Woman-owned and focused on creating a space that inspires other women to seek out their passions and live their best lives.
